question: Should PR 100461 become the maintained Control UI composer/model-picker direction after current-head proof and merge readiness are refreshed?
rationale: The branch is broad, user-visible, maintainer-labeled, and partially overlaps a recently merged composer redesign; source review found no concrete line-level blocker, but final UI direction cannot be decided deterministically.

options.title: Land after acceptance
options.body: Proceed once maintainers confirm current-head visual/product behavior and relevant CI or browser proof are acceptable.

options.title: Request fresh proof
options.body: Ask for fresh current-head screenshots, recording, or web UI chat proof before deciding on the redesign.

options.title: Split or pause
options.body: Separate the gateway/model availability fixes from the broad composer redesign if maintainers want a narrower landing path.

recommendation.title: Land after acceptance
recommendation.body: Proceed once maintainers confirm current-head visual/product behavior and relevant CI or browser proof are acceptable.
